scope: The one required set of programs and libraries Studio's tools and engines use, how the environment check finds each, the minimum it needs, the newest version known on the check date, how to install it, and for each host (ordinary ChatGPT, ChatGPT Work, Codex, Claude Code, the Claude apps) whether it was observed there, must be checked, is installed by the user, is installed into the Studio workspace with npm ci, or cannot run there. Every tool is required; the final check at installation, and the update check after each plugin update, pass only when every tool the host can run is present, with the workspace matching the plugin's lockfiles; the update check also lists newer versions. The check never installs anything; known_latest is a dated snapshot and --online reads the current versions.

hosts.label: Codex (CLI, IDE or app on the user's machine)
Claude Code (CLI, IDE or desktop app on the user's machine)
Claude apps (claude.ai web, desktop chat, mobile) with code execution
hosts.detect: /mnt/user-data exists and CLAUDECODE is not set (Claude Code cloud sessions have the folder too)

host_statuses.observed: reported working on this host by the owner; the check still runs before a file is promised
host_statuses.check: may be present in this host's sandbox; only running the check shows it
host_statuses.install: the user's own machine; install it when the check reports it missing
host_statuses.per_project: installed into the Studio workspace (a copy of the plugin's starter with npm ci from its lockfile); needs network once
host_statuses.not_supported: this host cannot run it; Studio delivers the capability card's alternative

workspace.note: The final check looks for each starter's node_modules here; --workspace names another folder.
